environment.description: Same Rails application on EKS 1.28 cluster. Namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' level). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-and-privileged' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing securityContext.privileged: true, hostPath volumes, or runAsUser: 0. The container runs as UID 1000 (nonroot) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. A writable emptyDir is mounted only at /tmp with a 100Mi sizeLimit. The ImageMagick policy.xml restricts delegates and disables ephemeral/URL coders. Seccomp profile set to RuntimeDefault blocking execve of non-allowlisted binaries via a custom OPA-based admission controller that injects a seccomp profile allowing only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, ioctl, fcntl, clone3, execve(convert only), exit_group, futex, getpid, rt_sigaction.
